maya.p: Heads-up — EdgeScale partner just sent a new usage payload variant that broke our ingest tests this morning. They used `usage_minutes` instead of `usage_seconds` and omitted `idempotency_key` in a subset of events.

liam.s: Can you paste a sample message so we can see exact shape? thx

maya.p: Sample from partner: ```json
{
  "customer_id": "C-123",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T14:00:00Z",
  "usage_minutes": 5
}
```

ara.k: Ugh. We currently expect `usage_seconds` or a `units` field. Two options: 1) convert minutes->seconds at ingest, 2) require partner to change. I vote for conversion + audit event so we don't lose data.

jonah: Partner PM says minutes is canonical on their side for edge devices. They can emit `usage_seconds` if we give them a migration window. They also asked if we can accept both for backwards compat.

maya.p: @liam.s quick Q: what's the reconciliation impact if we do conversion at ingest vs normalizing later in ledger?

liam.s: If we convert at ingest (minutes -> seconds) we keep downstream systems consistent. Key caveat: idempotency keys must remain stable or dedupe will break. Also update ratecard logic (we price per-second internally). Converting earlier reduces reconciliation diffs.

ara.k: Proposed implementation: accept `usage_minutes` and `usage_seconds`, prefer `usage_seconds` if present. On ingest, compute `usage_seconds = usage_minutes * 60` when needed, set internal `canonical_unit` = "seconds", and emit a small audit event `{"converted_from": "minutes"}`. Add unit tests + sample payload fixtures. Low-risk patch to ingestion lambda.

maya.p: Draft rollout plan: 1) Ingest conversion + audit (engineers) — 2 days to patch + tests. 2) Partner notified to optionally switch to `usage_seconds` within a 2-week migration window. 3) Backfill/reconciliation for last 30 days once conversion is live.

jonah: I'll ask partner to add an explicit `reporting_unit` field in their next payloads (helps future-proof). Also will loop in their SI team to ensure transforms don't get lost in their chain.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: schedule release freeze window 2026-03-25 00:00 UTC for billing schema changes.

liam.s: Also need to update entitlement mapping — EdgeScale uses labels like `tier=A` while our ledger expects `A-1`. We should add a mapping table and unit tests. That will affect aggregation and discount buckets.

maya.p: Action items: @ara.k open PR for ingestion conversion and audit event, @liam.s update ratecard and reconciliation tests, @jonah coordinate partner notification and migration timeline. I'll draft partner email and the backfill runbook.

ara.k: I'll open the PR today and include sample payloads + conversion logic. Quick ask: for backfill, do we run a ledger replay or apply a DB patch?

liam.s: Prefer ledger replay for full auditability. That requires a maintenance window and replay tooling run against sanitized inputs. We'll scope effort in PR.

maya.p: OK. I'll coordinate maintenance window with infra and confirm partner's acceptance. Thanks team :thumbsup:
